_README: Portal clients. Add a client here, run sync_portal.py <slug>, then
build_portal.py <slug>, then deploy to html/reports/<slug>/.
gsc_property must be EXACTLY as Search Console lists it - either the
URL-prefix form ('https://example.com/') or the domain form
('sc-domain:example.com'). Prefer sc-domain where it exists: it covers
www + non-www + http + https as one property, which matters on sites that
have historically been indexed under more than one of those.
ga4_property is the numeric property id, or null. Null is not a failure -
the page renders an explicit 'not connected' panel. Never substitute zeros
for a source that is not wired up; a client cannot tell a fake 0 from a
real one.
ai_log_dir may be null here and supplied instead by 'portal_ai_log_dirs'
in ~/.claude-tools/azwebcorp-creds.json, keyed by slug. Some clients' log
paths contain their hosting account name, which is half a credential pair
and does not belong in a public repository.
live_feed: true only where html/reports/<slug>/api/live.php exists with its
own GA4 service-account key. The page then polls that absolute path, so it
works from the agency view too, where a relative 'api/live.php' would
resolve against /reports/_owner/ and 404. Leave it out and the page says
the live feed is not connected for that property, which is the truth.
emails: addresses allowed to sign in to THIS client's dashboard at
https://azwebcorp.com/reports/ . One address belongs to one client; if the
same address is listed twice the last entry wins. Leaving the list empty
means nobody can reach that dashboard - the gate fails closed on purpose,
so an empty roster locks people out rather than letting anyone in.
